protocol: AI-assisted visual review of six frames per 1.875s source window, labels and model scores hidden in contact sheets; judgments frozen before reading private mapping.
limitations: Short sampled sequences can miss brief contacts or context; uncertain means unresolved, not normal.
Some scenes had already been seen in earlier audits; hiding labels does not erase prior scene familiarity.
48 source-stratified random clips plus 12 error-enriched clips; not a population noise-rate estimate.
